limitations: Public metrics are provider-reported impressions, not unique people or subscriber attribution. Search API availability cannot prove visibility in every user timeline or rule out ranking restrictions.

No anonymous requests were made to Macro Bias tracked campaign destinations, avoiding synthetic acquisition traffic. Profile HTTP shells/login responses alone are not proof of a suspension or shadowban.

recentTimeline.observation: Older replies show reported impressions including 125 and 36, versus one impression across the four current standalone experiment posts. Different dates/audiences and tiny samples do not prove a causal format advantage.

recommendations.reason: There is no pinned post and the account has one follower.

recommendations.action: Prioritise relevant, permitted participation in existing audiences over increasing unattended standalone post frequency.
recommendations.reason: Current profile, recent search API, all four posts and anonymous embed are accessible; near-zero audience is directly observed. Do not infer a shadowban or automate unsolicited replies.

conclusion: No explicit protected/withheld signal, successful authenticated and anonymous post retrieval, and all four experiment posts returned by recent search. No evidence of broken delivery or link-card failure in this audit. Account has one follower and no pinned introduction; observed reach is negligible. Search/ranking restriction absence is not established.
